candidate_relations.reason: Kimura disease typically presents with head or neck subcutaneous masses and characteristic lymphoid/eosinophilic findings, not the isolated persistent non-pitting facial edema and dermal lymphatic ectasia described.
Chronic lymphatic edema is compatible with the persistent non-pitting swelling and ectatic dermal lymphatics but does not identify the requested entity, solid persistent facial edema.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: General pathophysiologic category lacking the specific facial edema diagnosis

candidate_relations.reason: Blepharochalasis is characterized by recurrent eyelid swelling followed by thin, lax eyelid skin, unlike this continuous solid unilateral periorbital edema.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Distinct recurrent eyelid edema syndrome with tissue laxity
